teaser: You are halfway out the door, keys already in hand, calling back one more thing before it's lost. Life path 5 moves like that — toward the next room, the next city, the next version of a life — and ENFJ rarely leaves alone. This life path asks for freedom; these four letters ask for someone to bring along. The two don't quite oppose each other, they tangle: you want the open road and you want it full of people you've convinced to come, which means half of staying free is explaining to someone why you're leaving again.
